educational_rationale.topic: Public Key Authentication vs Password Brute Force & Service Account Baselines
educational_rationale.certification_relevance: Security+ SY0-701 (Section 3.3 Identity and Access Management) & Network+ (Section 4.1 Secure Protocols - SSH Port 22 & Public Key Infrastructure)
educational_rationale.deep_dive: Notice the difference in sshd logs between malicious brute-forcing ('Failed password for invalid user from public IP') and legitimate infrastructure-as-code automation ('Accepted publickey for ansible_service from 10.0.8.10'). When investigating SSH alerts, examine whether the auth type was password or publickey, verify the source hostname in CMDB, and verify that password authentication is disabled on service accounts.
